sla_notes_details: Basic accounting packages allow users to set up a chart of accounts, enter transactions such as sales, purchases, receipts and payments through data entry screens, and automatically post the entries to the relevant ledger accounts using built-in double-entry logic. This reduces arithmetic errors and speeds up the recording process compared to manual book-keeping.
sla_notes_illustrations: Entering a cash sale of TSh 70,000 into an accounting package's sales screen automatically posts a debit of TSh 70,000 to the Cash Account and a credit of TSh 70,000 to the Sales Account in the system's ledgers.
sla_notes_daily_life: A shop that uses a computer program to record daily sales instead of a paper sales book is applying accounting software in everyday business.
sla_exercise: What is an accounting package?::A computer program used to record, process and report business financial transactions.||State one advantage of using an accounting package over manual book-keeping.::It reduces arithmetic errors and automatically posts double entries, saving time.||What must be set up in an accounting package before transactions can be entered?::A chart of accounts, listing all the accounts to be used by the business.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate mastery of the use of ICT in Book-keeping
specific_competence_name: Use basic accounting packages
learning_activity_name: Analyse simple financial data by using accounting packages
sla_name: Analysing Financial Data with Accounting Software
sla_assessment_criteria: Learners correctly use an accounting package to analyse simple financial data such as sales trends and account balances.
sla_references: TET(2023), BOOK-KEEPING SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Beyond recording transactions, accounting packages provide tools to analyse financial data, such as generating reports and summaries automatically.
sla_notes_details: Accounting packages can produce reports such as trial balances, aged debtor listings and sales summaries at the click of a button, allowing users to quickly identify trends, such as which month had the highest sales or which customers owe the most money, without manually recalculating figures.
sla_notes_illustrations: An accounting package's sales report may instantly show that total sales for March were TSh 1,200,000 compared to TSh 900,000 in February, highlighting a TSh 300,000 increase without any manual addition.
sla_notes_daily_life: A business owner who checks a computer-generated report to see which month had the best sales, instead of adding up receipts by hand, is analysing financial data using an accounting package.
sla_exercise: State one type of report an accounting package can generate for analysis.::A trial balance report (also sales summary or aged debtors report).||Why is analysing data using an accounting package faster than manual methods?::Because the software automatically calculates and summarises figures from recorded transactions instead of requiring manual recalculation.||Give one example of a financial trend that can be identified from an accounting package's sales report.::An increase or decrease in monthly sales compared to the previous month.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate mastery of the use of ICT in Book-keeping
specific_competence_name: Use basic accounting packages
learning_activity_name: Apply basic accounting packages to produce financial statements
sla_name: Producing Financial Statements Using Accounting Software
sla_assessment_criteria: Learners correctly use an accounting package to generate an income statement and statement of financial position from recorded data.
sla_references: TET(2023), BOOK-KEEPING SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Once transactions are recorded in an accounting package, the software can automatically generate financial statements directly from the ledger data.
sla_notes_details: After all transactions for a period are entered, the accounting package uses its built-in templates to compile the Income Statement and Statement of Financial Position, drawing figures straight from the posted ledger balances, which saves time and reduces the risk of manual computation errors.
sla_notes_illustrations: After entering all of a shop's transactions for the month, the accounting package automatically generates an Income Statement showing Sales of TSh 1,000,000, Cost of Sales of TSh 600,000, and Net Profit of TSh 250,000 after expenses of TSh 150,000.
sla_notes_daily_life: A small business owner who clicks a button in accounting software to instantly produce this month's profit report, instead of preparing it by hand, is applying accounting packages to produce financial statements.
sla_exercise: What must be done before an accounting package can produce financial statements?::All relevant transactions for the period must first be correctly recorded in the system.||State one benefit of generating financial statements using an accounting package.::It saves time and reduces the risk of manual computation errors.||Name the two main financial statements an accounting package can generate from ledger data.::The Income Statement and the Statement of Financial Position.
